Goldenbridge is one of the fastest growing investment and wealth management firm of its kind specializing in goals-based wealth management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: &nbsp;Business Development Executive
Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	The Business Development Executive is responsible for sourcing, engaging, and managing relationships to drive asset growth and expanding the firm&rsquo;s Fund Under Management (FUM).
	The role requires strategic prospecting, strong relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of wealth management and investment products.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify, prospect, and onboard High Net Worth Individuals and institutional prospects.
	Develop and execute strategic plans to grow Fund Under Management (FUM).
	Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients through personalized financial solutions.
	Fund mobilization
	Present investment opportunities, portfolio strategies, and market insights to prospective clients.
	Collaborate with investment and product teams to tailor offerings to clients.
	Maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads and track progress using CRM tools.
	Organize client engagement events, investment forums, and networking sessions.
	Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies in client acquisition.
	Prepare periodic business development reports and performance metrics.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Volume and value of new HNI accounts acquired.
	Growth in Fund Under Management attributable to individual efforts.
	Client retention and satisfaction levels.
	Conversion rate from leads to funded accounts.
	Number of strategic relationship engagements monthly/quarterly.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or related field (Master&rsquo;s or professional certification is an advantage).
	Minimum of 8 years&rsquo; experience in wealth management, investment advisory, private banking, or financial services marketing.
	Proven track record of acquiring and managing HNI clients.
	Strong knowledge of investment products, capital markets, and portfolio strategies.


Competencies &amp; Skills:


	Excellent relationship management and negotiation skills.
	High level of professionalism, discretion, and integrity.
	Strong presentation and communication skills.
	Results-driven mindset with strong commercial acumen.
	Ability to work independently and meet growth targets.
	Strong network within HNI, corporate and professional circles.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: hiring@goldenbridge.com.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

        Goldenbridge is a leading provider of comprehensive wealth  management and investment products and services for individuals, companies, and institutions. Fully licensed and regulated by the Nigerian Stock Exchange. Goldenbridge is one of the fastest growing investment and wealth management firm of its kind specializing in goals-based wealth management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position:  Business Development Executive
Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary

	The Business Development Executive is responsible for sourcing, engaging, and managing relationships to drive asset growth and expanding the firm’s Fund Under Management (FUM).
	The role requires strategic prospecting, strong relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of wealth management and investment products.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify, prospect, and onboard High Net Worth Individuals and institutional prospects.
	Develop and execute strategic plans to grow Fund Under Management (FUM).
	Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients through personalized financial solutions.
	Fund mobilization
	Present investment opportunities, portfolio strategies, and market insights to prospective clients.
	Collaborate with investment and product teams to tailor offerings to clients.
	Maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads and track progress using CRM tools.
	Organize client engagement events, investment forums, and networking sessions.
	Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies in client acquisition.
	Prepare periodic business development reports and performance metrics.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Volume and value of new HNI accounts acquired.
	Growth in Fund Under Management attributable to individual efforts.
	Client retention and satisfaction levels.
	Conversion rate from leads to funded accounts.
	Number of strategic relationship engagements monthly/quarterly.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or related field (Master’s or professional certification is an advantage).
	Minimum of 8 years’ experience in wealth management, investment advisory, private banking, or financial services marketing.
	Proven track record of acquiring and managing HNI clients.
	Strong knowledge of investment products, capital markets, and portfolio strategies.

	Excellent relationship management and negotiation skills.
	High level of professionalism, discretion, and integrity.
	Strong presentation and communication skills.
	Results-driven mindset with strong commercial acumen.
	Ability to work independently and meet growth targets.
	Strong network within HNI, corporate and professional circles.

Content Creator Job at Scentimental




        
    

        
        Scentimental is a luxury home fragrance and lifestyle brand inspired by nostalgia, travel, and storytelling.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Content Creator

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time
Work arrangement: Hybrid

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Do you love storytelling, creating engaging content, and bringing brands to life? At Scentimental, we use fragrance to tell stories of travel, culture, memory, and discovery.
	We’re looking for a creative Content Creator to help us bring these stories to life and connect with our growing audience.


What you’ll do


	Create engaging social media content, including Reels, Stories, captions, and short-form videos.
	Translate fragrance, culture, and travel-inspired experiences into compelling brand stories.
	Plan content calendars and support campaigns, product launches, and seasonal collections.
	Capture behind-the-scenes content and showcase our products and brand experiences.
	Track content performance and use insights to improve engagement and reach.


What we’re looking for


	2–5 years of experience in content creation, social media, or digital marketing.
	Strong storytelling, writing, and copywriting skills.
	Experience creating short-form video and social media content.
	Good understanding of social media trends, audience engagement, and content performance.
